facts.fact: SARB's June 2026 SADC-RTGS statistics list Mozambique as a participating country with six participating banks (Absa, Access Bank, FNB, Nedbank, Mozabanco, Standard Bank).
SARB's June 2026 SADC-RTGS per-country table gives Mozambique 215 settled transactions with a value of ZAR 261.79 million.
